```{r}
#| label: tbl-num-inv-detailed
#| tbl-cap: "Detailed numerical inventory performance by forecasting method and replenishment policy."
#| tbl-pos: "H"

# read data ---------------------------------------------------------------

inv_path <- project_path("data/results/inv_df_num.rds")

inv_df_num <- read_rds(inv_path) |>
  mutate(
    model = case_when(
      model == "lr" ~ "Linear Regression",
      model == "lr_reg" ~ "Censored Linear Regression",
      model == "moving_average" ~ "Mean",
      model == "moving_average_reg" ~ "Censored Mean",
      model == "naive" ~ "Naive",
      model == "tckf" ~ "TCKF",
      model == "arima" ~ "ARIMA",
      model == "arima_reg" ~ "Censored ARIMA",
      model == "ets" ~ "ETS",
      model == "timegpt" ~ "TimeGPT",
      model == "timegpt_reg" ~ "Censored TimeGPT",
      model == "lgbm" ~ "LightGBM",
      model == "lgbm_reg" ~ "Censored LightGBM",
      model == "sba" ~ "Syntetos-Boylan Approx",
      .default = model
    ),
    policy = recode(
      policy,
      "deterministic" = "As-is policy",
      "myopic (k=5)" = "Myopic (k=5)",
      "myopic (k=10)" = "Myopic (k=10)",
      "myopic (k=20)" = "Myopic (k=20)",
      "upper_q80" = "Quantile 80",
      "upper_q85" = "Quantile 85",
      "upper_q90" = "Quantile 90",
      "upper_q95" = "Quantile 95",
      "capped" = "Capped",
      "oracle" = "Oracle"
    )
  ) |>
  filter(!policy %in% c("Capped", "Oracle"))

# plot styling ------------------------------------------------------------

policy_levels <- c(
  "As-is policy", "Myopic (k=5)", "Myopic (k=10)", "Myopic (k=20)",
  "Quantile 80", "Quantile 85", "Quantile 90", "Quantile 95"
)

model_levels <- c(
  "TCKF",
  "Censored Linear Regression",
  "Linear Regression",
  "Mean",
  "Censored Mean",
  "Naive",
  "Syntetos-Boylan Approx",
  "ARIMA",
  "Censored ARIMA",
  "ETS",
  "TimeGPT",
  "Censored TimeGPT",
  "LightGBM",
  "Censored LightGBM"
)

# summary -----------------------------------------------------------------

plot_df_num_inv <- inv_df_num |>
  filter(model != 'Censored LightGBM') |>
  group_by(policy, model) |>
  summarise(
    csl = mean(met_demand, na.rm = TRUE),
    lost_demand_rate = sum(lost_sales, na.rm = TRUE) / sum(demand, na.rm = TRUE),
    avg_inventory = mean((opening_stock + closing_stock) / 2, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    policy = factor(policy, levels = policy_levels),
    model = factor(model, levels = model_levels)
  )

num_inv_tbl <- plot_df_num_inv |>
  arrange(policy, model) |>
  transmute(
    `Inventory policy` = as.character(policy),
    Method = as.character(model),
    CSL = round(csl, 3),
    `Lost-demand rate` = round(lost_demand_rate, 3),
    `Avg. inventory` = round(avg_inventory, 2)
  )

num_inv_tbl |>
  knitr::kable(
    format = "latex",
    booktabs = TRUE,
    longtable = TRUE,
    linesep = "",
    align = "llrrr"
  ) |>
  kable_styling(
    font_size = 8,
    latex_options = "repeat_header"
  ) |>
  collapse_rows(columns = 1, latex_hline = "major") |>
  column_spec(1, width = "7em") |>
  column_spec(2, width = "12em") |>
  column_spec(3:5, width = "5em")
```
